task_definition.task_description: Please check the current time in New York, then look up the status of flight CA1234 and, if it looks fine, book it for John Doe in economy. After that, check the weather in Paris, send me an in-app medium-priority Trip Summary alert about it for user_001, and then create a high-priority reminder titled Trip Summary for 2026-02-22 10:04:54 with the description “Quarterly budget review.”
